name: Eisai to 108 nin no Otokotachi 2 Be Right Back
original_name: 栄西と108人の男達2 Be Right Back
source:
"I love you, I love you, I love you. 
I will love you forever even if you go......" 

Eisai and the 108 Guys is a reverse harem eroge set in old Kyoto. 
"You" have lost your memories and are tended by a peverse 
psychopath in a shrine where nothing but hot young guys are 
allowed to live. 

"I'll give you anything you want. Anything......" 

Eroticism, madness, pure love and vicious rivalries. 
A man who can't be saved risks gambles his life for you. 
From beginning to end, this is a love story. 

[From DLsite English]
translation:
“我爱你，我爱你，我爱你。
就算你离去，我也会永远爱你……”

《荣西与108位男子》是一款以古时京都为背景的逆后宫成人游戏。
“你”失去了记忆，受到一名变态而精神失常的人照料。这里是一座只允许俊美年轻男子居住的神社。

“你想要什么，我都会给你。什么都可以……”

情欲、疯狂、纯爱，以及残酷的竞争。
一个无可救药的男人，为你拿自己的性命作赌注。
从头到尾，这都是一个爱情故事。
